newsitem.title: USA: Community First Bankshares Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Community First Bankshares Q1 net rises.

text.p: Community First Bankshares Inc said Thursday an increase in non-interest income helped the bank holding company post record earnings in the first quarter ended March 31.

The company reported net income of $10.5 million, or $0.59 a share, compared to $8.6 million, or $0.50 fully diluted a year ago. The latest figure also includes an extraordinary charge of $0.01 to reflect the early extinguishment of debt, Community First said.
Non-interest income rose to $8.1 million from $5.9 million last year, the company said.
Community First shares were off 3/16 Thursday at 30.
